extensionDescription.message: Filters spam with local white and black lists learned from your sent mail. AI is asked only about mail from senders you have never written to.

permissionDeclined.message: The permission was not granted, so nothing was changed.

permissionTryAgain.message: Thunderbird refused part of the permission request. Press the button again: Block Spam will then ask for less.

errorNotReady.message: Block Spam is still starting. Try again in a moment.

errorAccessPointGone.message: This AI service no longer exists.

errorChatgptNeedsSignIn.message: A ChatGPT plan service is added by signing in.

errorFolderPermission.message: Thunderbird has not made folder creation available yet. Create the folder in Thunderbird and choose it here.

errorScoringRunning.message: Selected messages are already being scored.

errorTypeChange.message: The type of an AI service cannot be changed. Remove it and add a new one.

invalid_entry_invalid.message: Enter an email address such as name@example.com or a domain such as example.com.

invalid_address_invalid.message: Enter an email address such as name@example.com.

invalid_prompt_empty.message: An empty prompt cannot be saved.

invalid_own_address.message: This is one of your own addresses, so nothing was changed.

invalid_no_sender.message: This entry has no sender to act on.

blockAndTrustLead.message: Block or trust the sender of the selected messages with a shortcut, the Block Spam button in the toolbar or the context menu.

advancedLead.message: Settings that rarely need a change: which domains count as public mail providers, and which mailboxes forward mail in their own name.

backupLead.message: Save the lists, the settings and the AI services to a file, or load them from one.

overviewLead.message: Block Spam moves mail from blocked senders to Junk, never touches mail from people you write to, and can ask an AI about everyone else.

protectionHint.message: New mail in monitored folders is checked against the lists, and mail from blocked senders goes to Junk. Mail that arrived before protection was switched on is never touched.

protectionMore.message: Mail from senders on neither list is scored by an AI service if you added one. Otherwise it follows the setting under Incoming mail. Learning from sent mail, the shortcuts and the buttons of the toolbar panel work whether protection is on or off.

statusTodayNone.message: No mail was checked today yet.

statusAiOff.message: All AI services are switched off.

warnAiBeforeScan.message: An AI service is switched on, but the white list holds only your own addresses. Mail from people you already write to would be sent to the AI.

warnAiBeforeScanFix.message: Scan your sent mail first: step 1 of Setup below.

warnNoJunk.message: $1 has no Junk folder, so spam in this account stays where it is. Enable junk handling for the account in Thunderbird, or create a Junk folder.

warnNeedsAttention.message: The AI service $1 is not used.

warnNoScreening.message: Mail without an AI verdict goes to a screening folder, but $1 has none, so its mail stays where it is.

warnAiDown.message: No AI service is working at the moment, so mail from unknown senders gets no AI verdict.

remedy_key_rejected.message: The key was rejected. Edit this service and enter a valid key.

remedy_key_missing.message: Its key is missing. Edit this service and enter the key.

remedy_permission.message: This computer has not allowed its host yet. Edit this service and press Save.

remedy_sign_in.message: You are not signed in. Use Continue with ChatGPT in its row.

remedy_plan_refused.message: OpenAI refused to use this plan. Sign in again, or check the plan in ChatGPT settings.

step1Text.message: Everyone you have written to goes on the white list, so their mail is never sent to an AI.

step2Text.message: It scores mail from senders you have never written to. Without one, such mail stays where it is.

step3Text.message: From then on new mail is checked. Mail that is already in your folders is never touched.

scanFirstText.message: The scan puts everyone you have written to on the white list. It reads only the recipients of your sent mail and uses no AI.

observationLabel.message: Only observe: decide and log, but move nothing

observationHint.message: No message is moved and the AI adds nothing to the black list. The log shows what would have happened. Use it to try a model, a prompt or a cutoff before you trust them.

observationOff.message: Protection is off, so nothing is observed yet.

byHandKeys.message: Select a message and press $1 to block or $2 to trust its sender, or use the Block Spam button in the toolbar or the context menu of the message.

byHandNoKeys.message: Select a message and use the Block Spam button in the toolbar, or the context menu of the message, to block or trust its sender.

byHandAll.message: All ways to block and trust

fatalText.message: Block Spam could not read its stored data. Protection is off and nothing is written until this is resolved. Nothing is repaired automatically.

fatalRepairLead.message: Only stored settings are wrong. You can set each of them back to its default on its own, and everything else stays as it is:

fatalRepairText.message: $1: the stored value is not valid. Default: $2.

fatalRepaired.message: The setting “$1” was set back to its default: $2.

fatalLastResort.message: If that does not help, the last resort is to reset everything:

fatalDownloadHint.message: The raw data contains your API keys and sign-in tokens. Keep the file private.

fatalResetText.message: This deletes the lists, the settings, the AI services with their keys and the log, and ends ChatGPT sign-ins. It cannot be undone. Download the raw data first if you may need it.

scanHint.message: Reads the recipients of the mail in the Sent folders above and adds them to the white list. Running it again is harmless.

scanDatesHint.message: Both dates are optional. Type the day, month and year in the order the field shows, or pick a day from its calendar. An empty field sets no limit on that side.

scanRangeInvalid.message: The end date is before the start date.

scanRunning.message: Scanning folder $1 of $2 ($3). Messages read: $4. Entries added: $5.

scanRunningOf.message: Scanning folder $1 of $2 ($3). Messages read: $4 of $6. Entries added: $5.

scanDone.message: Scan finished. Messages read: $1. Entries added: $2.

scanDoneEmpty.message: Scan finished. No sent mail was found in the Sent folders.

scanCancelled.message: Scan cancelled. Messages read: $1. Entries added: $2. The entries learned so far are kept.

listsHint.message: A sender is matched by address first, then by domain, so an address entry always beats a domain entry.

listsMore.message: A blocked address stays blocked inside a trusted domain, and a trusted person passes inside a blocked domain. The white list is learned from your sent mail. The black list holds senders you blocked and senders the AI scored as spam.

listsMovedWhite.message: Moved $1 from the black list to the white list.

listsMovedBlack.message: Moved $1 from the white list to the black list.

newEntriesLabel.message: Entries created by learning, by AI and by blocking or trusting are:

newEntriesHint.message: Changing this affects future entries only. Entries you add by hand above choose for themselves.

logHint.message: The last 5000 decisions of Block Spam, without the text of any message.

logUndoHint.message: To undo a decision, use the button in its row.

logUndoHintKey.message: To undo a decision, use the button in its row, or select the message and press $1.

logSearchLabel.message: Search the log by sender or subject

logClearText.message: All logged decisions are deleted. The lists are not affected.

actionObserved_screening.message: would go to the screening folder

reason_white_address.message: The address is on the white list

reason_white_domain.message: The domain is on the white list

reason_black_address.message: The address is on the black list

reason_black_domain.message: The domain is on the black list

reason_ai_above.message: The AI score is above the cutoff

reason_ai_below.message: The AI score is not above the cutoff

reason_no_ai.message: No AI service is switched on

reason_sender_unparsed.message: The sender could not be read

reason_no_junk_folder.message: The account has no Junk folder

reason_no_screening_folder.message: The account has no screening folder

reason_move_failed.message: The message could not be moved

reason_whitelisted.message: The sender was added to the white list

reason_failed.message: The message could not be handled

logWouldAdd.message: Would be added to the black list: $1

logWouldAddScoped.message: Would be added to the black list: $1 ($2)

logTrustedNowTitle.message: $1 is on the white list. The message was never moved.

logTrustMoveTitle.message: Trust $1 and move the message back to the Inbox

logBlockTitle.message: Block $1 and move the message to Junk

logMoveInboxTitle.message: Move to Inbox: $1 is already trusted, so only the message is moved back

logMoveJunkTitle.message: Move to Junk: $1 is already blocked, so only the message is moved

logDoneTrusted.message: $1 is on the white list now.

logDoneBlocked.message: $1 is on the black list now.

logAlreadyTrusted.message: $1 was already on the white list.

logAlreadyBlocked.message: $1 was already on the black list.

logMovedInbox.message: The message is back in the Inbox.

logMovedJunk.message: The message was moved to Junk.

logMoveNotFound.message: The message was not found, so nothing was moved.

logMoveNoInbox.message: The account has no Inbox, so the message stays where it is.

logMoveNoJunk.message: The account has no Junk folder, so the message stays where it is.

logMoveFailed.message: The message could not be moved: $1

learningHint.message: Everyone you write to goes on the white list: the whole domain for a company, the single address at a public mail provider.

learningMore.message: Learning reads only the recipients of your sent mail, never uses AI, and never overrides a block you set by hand. It works whether protection is on or off.

sentFoldersHint.message: These folders are watched for new sent mail, also mail sent from a phone or from webmail, and are read by the scan.

incomingHint.message: New mail in monitored folders is checked when it arrives, when Thunderbird starts and every 5 minutes, also when it was read on another device first.

monitoredHint.message: The Inbox of every account is always monitored. Add folders that receive new mail directly, for example through a server-side rule.

noVerdictLabel.message: When no AI service is set up or all of them failed:

noVerdictLeave.message: Leave the message where it is

noVerdictScreening.message: Move it to the screening folder

screeningHint.message: A folder between the Inbox and Junk for mail from unknown senders. When a sender is added to the white list, their messages move from there to the Inbox.

aiLead.message: Only mail from senders on neither list is sent to an AI service, and mail from senders on your white list never is.

aiHint.message: The AI receives the sender, the Reply-To address if there is one, the recipients, the subject, the date and the first 20,000 characters of the text, and can answer with nothing but a probability from 0.00 to 1.00.

aiSecretsHint.message: API keys and sign-in tokens are stored unencrypted in your Thunderbird profile. They are never written to the log and never exported.

privacyText.message: Nothing else leaves this computer, apart from messages you score yourself as a test. There is no telemetry and no other network request.

servicesHint.message: Services are tried from top to bottom and the first valid score is final. When one fails or runs out of quota, the next one takes over.

servicesNone.message: No AI service yet. Without one, mail from unknown senders follows the setting under Incoming mail.

presetHint_jev.message: The decision model of TypeSafe. It can answer with nothing but a probability, and it is the cheapest and fastest choice.

presetHint_openrouter_decisions.message: Jev and other decision models through an OpenRouter account.

presetHint_cloudflare_clef.message: The decision model of Cloudflare, billed through your Cloudflare account. It needs your account id and an API token.

presetHint_local_systemone.message: A decision model that basal serves on this computer, for example Bielik-One. No mail leaves the computer.

presetHint_openai_decisions.message: The Decisions endpoint of OpenAI with gpt-6-luna. It uses an OpenAI API key.

presetHint_openai.message: The chat models of OpenAI, with an API key.

presetHint_gemini.message: Gemini, with an API key from Google AI Studio.

presetHint_openrouter.message: Any chat model through an OpenRouter account.

presetHint_ollama.message: A model that Ollama runs on this computer. No mail leaves the computer.

presetHint_lmstudio.message: A model that LM Studio runs on this computer. No mail leaves the computer.

presetHint_custom.message: Any service or local bridge that speaks the OpenAI chat format. You enter its address.

presetHint_anthropic.message: Claude, with an Anthropic API key. The Max, Ultra and Team plans include monthly API credits.

presetHint_chatgpt.message: ChatGPT Plus, Pro or Business. You sign in on the page of OpenAI. No API key is needed, and the use counts against your plan.

apCoolingDown.message: Paused until $1 after a rate limit. The next service takes over meanwhile.

apLastErrorRetry.message: The last request failed. $1 It is tried again when needed.

apTestScore.message: Works: the sample spam email scored $1.

diag_timeout.message: The service did not answer within $1 seconds.

diag_network.message: The service could not be reached.

diag_usage_limit.message: The usage limit of the plan is reached.

diag_renew_failed.message: The sign-in could not be renewed.

diag_no_permission.message: This computer has not allowed the host $1 yet. Edit the service and press Save.

diag_answer_missing.message: The answer of the service held no score.

diag_not_number.message: The answer was not a number from 0.00 to 1.00.

diag_endpoint_invalid.message: The address of the service is not valid.

apRemoveText.message: The service and its key or sign-in are deleted from this computer.

endpointHint_systemone.message: The full address of the decision endpoint. For Cloudflare, replace <account id> with your account id.

endpointHint_openai_chat.message: The base address, without /chat/completions. Only addresses on this computer may use http.

modelHint_systemone.message: Leave empty for a local server that serves a single model.

modelHint_openai_decisions.message: The decision model, for example gpt-6-luna.

modelHint_openai_chat.message: The model name as the provider spells it. Load models lists what the server offers.

modelHint_anthropic.message: A Claude model id, for example claude-opus-5-5, or claude-haiku-5-5 for lower cost.

modelHint_chatgpt.message: Load models lists the models of your ChatGPT account.

keyKeep.message: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.

keyHint.message: Stored unencrypted in your Thunderbird profile. Servers on this computer usually need no key.

loadModelsDone.message: Models loaded: $1. Choose one from the menu.

problem_endpoint_insecure.message: The address must start with https. Only localhost and 127.0.0.1 may use http.

problem_endpoint_placeholder.message: Replace the placeholder in the address with your own value.

consentTitle.message: Send mail from unknown senders to this service?

consentText.message: Block Spam will send mail from senders who are on neither list to $1, in the background, to get a spam probability.

consentWhat.message: What is sent: the sender, the Reply-To address if there is one, the recipients, the subject, the date and the first 20,000 characters of the text. Attachments, remote content and other headers are never sent.

consentNever.message: Mail from senders on your white list is never sent anywhere.

localServerHint.message: A server on this computer rejects requests from add-ons unless it is told to allow the origin of this add-on:

localServerHow.message: For Ollama set OLLAMA_ORIGINS to this value. For basal pass it to --cors-origins.

cutoffLabel.message: A message is spam when its score is greater than:

cutoffHint.message: From 0.00 to 1.00. The default is 0.85. A higher cutoff lets more spam through, a lower one risks blocking wanted mail.

promptHint.message: The question the AI answers about each email. Decision models get it as their instructions, chat models as their system prompt.

promptLanguage.message: The default prompt is in English because that is what the model reads, and you can write yours in any language.

outputLineLabel.message: For chat models this line is always added. It cannot be changed:

chatgptConsentText.message: Block Spam will send mail from senders who are on neither list to OpenAI, in the background, to get a spam probability. These requests use your ChatGPT plan.

chatgptConsentManage.message: You sign in on the page of OpenAI. Block Spam never sees your password. You can review and limit the usage in ChatGPT settings at any time.

chatgptRevocationTitle.message: The session may still be open

chatgptRevocationUnconfirmed.message: The sign-in was removed from this computer, but OpenAI did not confirm that the session ended. You can disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings.

chatgptWelcomeText.message: Scoring mail from unknown senders in Block Spam now uses your ChatGPT plan. You can review and manage the usage in ChatGPT settings.

signInWaiting.message: Finish signing in in the tab that opened. This page updates by itself when the sign-in completes.

signInManual.message: Finish signing in in the tab that opened, or in your browser. Then paste the address you were redirected to below.

signInPasteHint.message: If this page does not update by itself: at the end of the sign-in the browser tries to open an address that starts with http://127.0.0.1:1455 and shows an error page. That is expected. Copy that address from the address bar and paste it here.

signInNoneInProgress.message: No sign-in is in progress. Start again.

signInTimedOut.message: The sign-in took too long and was cancelled.

signInError_state_mismatch.message: The address belongs to a different sign-in attempt.

signInError_wrong_address.message: This is not the address the sign-in redirects to. It starts with http://127.0.0.1:1455/auth/callback.

signInError_denied.message: Access was declined on the OpenAI page.

signInError_no_code.message: The address contains no authorization code.

signInError_registration_incomplete.message: The registration did not return a client id. Start the sign-in again.

signInError_client_mismatch.message: The sign-in returned a different client id. Start the sign-in again.

signInError_exchange_failed.message: The authorization code could not be exchanged: $1

signInError_invalid_token.message: The ID token is not valid: $1

signInError_account_mismatch.message: A different ChatGPT account signed in. Sign in with the account of this service, or add a new service.

signInError_plan_not_enabled.message: Permission to use your ChatGPT plan was not granted, so the service cannot be used. Start the sign-in again and allow plan use.

shortcutsHint.message: The shortcuts act on the selected messages, or on the message shown in a tab or window. Block moves the messages to Junk. Trust moves them back to the Inbox from Junk or from a screening folder.

shortcutsMore.message: Your own messages are ignored. Blocking and trusting by hand work in observation mode and while protection is off. After a shortcut or the context menu, a desktop notification says what was done, and the Block Spam panel in the toolbar offers Undo.

shortcutsRebindHint.message: Opens Thunderbird's own list of shortcuts. You also find it under Add-ons and Themes, in the gear menu, Manage Extension Shortcuts.

smartLabel.message: Smart: use the address for senders at public mail providers

smartHint.message: With Smart on, the domain shortcuts block or trust a company as a whole domain and a sender at a provider such as gmail.com by address. With Smart off they always use the domain.

otherWaysTitle.message: Toolbar button, context menu and log

otherWaysPopup.message: Select one or more messages and click the Block Spam button in the toolbar. The panel says what the lists hold about the sender, offers buttons to block and to trust, and Undo for the last command.

otherWaysMenu.message: Right-click a message in the message list and choose Block Spam.

otherWaysLog.message: Every decision has a button in its row that undoes it.

bareKeysTitle.message: The keys B and W on their own

bareKeysHint.message: Thunderbird lets an add-on capture keys without a modifier only through an Experiment, and an add-on with an Experiment must ask for full access to Thunderbird and your computer. Block Spam never does.

bareKeysSteps.message: If you accept that permission, install the separate add-on Block Spam Keys:

bareKeysStepSave.message: Save its file to your computer:

bareKeysStepInstall.message: Open Add-ons and Themes, click the gear menu, choose Install Add-on From File and pick the saved file.

bareKeysCaptures.message: From then on it captures $1 in mail windows and passes them on to Block Spam.

publicHint.message: At a public provider such as gmail.com every address is a different person, so the lists hold single addresses there. For any other domain the whole company is trusted or blocked as one domain.

publicMore.message: The built-in list has $1 providers. Changing it affects future entries only.

publicInvalid.message: Enter a domain such as example.com.

publicIsPublic.message: $1 is treated as a public provider: entries are made per address.

publicIsCustom.message: $1 is treated as a company domain: entries are made for the whole domain.

publicRemovedTitle.message: Treated as company domains by you

forwardingHint.message: Some mailboxes forward mail to you in their own name, so the message shows the forwarding mailbox as its sender. Add them here: their messages are then judged by the original sender.

forwardingHowTo.message: How to tell: if a forwarded message shows the original author as its sender, nothing needs to be configured. If it shows the mailbox that forwarded it, add that mailbox here once.

forwardingMore.message: The trust of a forwarding mailbox is never passed on: a message whose original sender cannot be found counts as mail from an unknown sender.

forwardLabelsHint.message: When the original sender is not in the message headers, it is read from the first line of the text that starts with one of these labels. Separate the labels with commas.

forwardLabelsMore.message: Only after that is an attached message looked at. Add the label your forwarding mailbox writes before the original sender.

exportHint.message: One file with the lists, the settings and the AI services, without their keys and sign-ins. Entries and folders of an account are saved with the account's email address.

exportDone.message: The file was handed to Thunderbird for saving.

exportSkipped.message: Exported. Items of accounts that no longer exist were left out: $1.

importHint.message: Merge adds the entries of the file to your lists and leaves settings and AI services untouched. Replace overwrites lists, settings and AI services.

importMore.message: After Replace, keys must be entered again and the ChatGPT sign-in repeated. Importing never switches protection on. Items that belong to an account follow the account with the same email address here. The others are skipped and reported.

importNotJson.message: This file is not a Block Spam export.

importReplaceTitle.message: Replace lists, settings and AI services?

importReplaceText.message: Your current lists, settings and AI services are replaced by the file. Keys and sign-ins are removed from this computer.

importEntries.message: Entries added: $1. Moved from the other list: $2. Already there: $3.

importReplaced.message: The settings were replaced. AI services imported: $1. Enter their keys again.

importSkippedAccount.message: Skipped $1: no account with the address $2.

importSkippedFolder.message: Skipped the folder $1: it does not exist here.

popupDataProblemText.message: Block Spam could not read its stored data. Protection is off until this is resolved in the settings.

popupSetupText.message: Scan your sent mail first, so that mail from people you write to is never blocked or sent to an AI.

popupNoSelection.message: Select a message to block or trust its sender here.

popupDecisionLabel.message: Decision about this message: $1, $2. Show in the log.

popupNoChange.message: Nothing to change: the sender is on this list already.

popupPublicNote.message: This is a public mail provider, so only this address is blocked or trusted.

popupOwnAddress.message: This is one of your own addresses.

popupUnknownSender.message: The original sender is not known. The message is moved, but no entry is added.

popupScoreConfirm.message: Selected messages: $1. Their content will be sent to the configured AI, also for senders on your lists. Nothing is moved and no entry is created. The scores appear in the log.

popupScoreTooMany.message: Select at most $1 messages to score them in one run.

popupScoreDone.message: Scored: $1. Without a score: $2. The scores are in the log.

popupNothingSelected.message: Select one or more messages in the message list first.

notifyUnknownSender.message: Forwarded messages whose original sender is not known: $1. No entry was added for them.

notifyMoveFailed.message: Some messages could not be moved: $1

notifyNoInbox.message: The account has no Inbox folder

notifyUndoHint.message: To undo, click the Block Spam button in the toolbar.

commandUndone.message: Undone. The lists are as they were before.

commandUndoNotFound.message: No longer found, so not moved back: $1

badgeDataProblem.message: Block Spam: stored data is not valid
